Properties

We acquire, enhance, and hold quality assets which can synergise with and strengthen our portfolio.

With our home in Hong Kong, we are interested in opportunities in Hong Kong, the tier-one cities in Chinese Mainland and their surrounding river delta areas or other markets where suitable opportunities arise. Optimising portfolio value and asset performance, we seek to bring about exceptional customer experiences and thriving businesses for our tenants and customers.
